title: British Breakfast Quesadillas
description: A twist on traditional breakfast quesadillas, featuring British breakfast ingredients in a Mexican-inspired dish. This recipe combines the savory flavors of the UK with the vibrant spices of Mexico.

ingredients.name: chili powder
ingredients.notes: mild or hot, depending on taste

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the cooking oil and swirl to coat.
Add the sausages and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausages from the skillet and set aside.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cumin and chili powder to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the cooked mushrooms and sausages to the bowl and stir to combine.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Place a tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle shredded cheese on half of the tortilla.
Add the egg mixture on top of the cheese.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the other side is also crispy and the cheese is melted.
